title: Unset versus empty
hints: os.Getenv returns "" both when the variable is unset and when it's set to the empty string. You can't tell the two apart with it.
os.LookupEnv returns the value and a bool that says whether the variable exists at all.
Use the default only when ok is false. Then parse with strconv.Atoi, and reject numbers outside 1 to 65535.
